key_facts: Aug 7 MAJOR UPDATE (T+1d; Exa Xinhua 20:22 Aug 7, Fujian Met 16:00 Aug 7, CMA 18:00 Yellow Warning via Jin10/21jingji, Chinanews 20:12 Aug 7, HK01/TVBS 08:45 Aug 7; UPDATED concentrating on Wenzhou-Taizhou-Ningde & swapping Shanghai->Fuzhou): At 17:00 CST Aug 7, Severe Typhoon Dolphin (#13) strengthened to Force 15 (48 m/s, 940 hPa; possible Force 16 Super Typhoon) at 26.9N, 128.0E — 730 km due E of Wenzhou, jogging 0.3 deg S from 05:00 (27.2N, 129.8E) while moving W at ~15 km/h into East China Sea tonight. CMA 18:00 Yellow Warning forecasts Aug 9 afternoon-Aug 10 morning landfall along Zhejiang to northern Fujian coast (Force 13-14, 40-45 m/s), dropping Shanghai from the landfall wording; Fujian Met upgraded to Level III at 16:00 narrowing the envelope to Ningbo, Zhejiang to Ningde, Fujian; HKO deterministic track map explicitly targets Wenzhou Sunday night Aug 9; Zhejiang issued 48h/72h Red wave warnings for Zhoushan/Ningbo/Taizhou/Wenzhou (Jiaxing Blue only); Fuzhou initiated Level-IV warning and aquaculture evacuations. CMA analyst Xin Xin says East China landfall is virtually certain; Typhoon #14 Kujira weakened to a tropical depression over Luzon, though subtropical-high/trough steering keeps ~110-130 km 48h track spread. Shifted: Wenzhou 0.26->0.34, Taizhou 0.20->0.23, Ningde 0.13->0.18, Ningbo 0.11->0.10, replaced Shanghai (0.06) with Fuzhou (0.06) (sum 0.91; 0.09 outside mass for county-level naming & tails).
next_review_trigger: FINAL DAY Aug 8: Check latest Aug 8 CMA/Zhejiang/Fujian/HKO track maps ~24-30h pre-landfall to sharpen Wenzhou vs Taizhou vs Ningde.
